decisions.reason: The Tables document is only the storage location for the new biographies; the decision does not change which tables must be integrated or replaced.
Replacing biography placeholders with completed biographies does not alter the fixed section order.
The source decision concerns biography content and does not change organization-chart inclusion or placement.
The general requirement to package all required RFQ content remains valid unchanged; the biography-specific population method is already represented by the source Requirement.
The biography source and placeholder replacement do not change the Blue Mesa brand identity or brand elements.
Inserting completed biographies does not change the existing font consistency rules.
The source message changes biography population only and does not affect photo sources, selection, or placement.
The biography-content update does not change Canva editing access, ownership, or asset policy.
The biography insertion decision applies to the current RFQ appendix and does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
Using completed biographies instead of placeholders does not change the required PDF format, count, export quality, or email submission behavior.
The source changes appendix content population but does not explicitly change full-document layout coverage or layout requirements.
The biography update does not change the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
